title: Broccoli Salad for a Crowd
description: A sweet and spicy mayonnaise dressing coats this quick and easy broccoli salad for a crowd, complete with trail mix and crispy bacon.
ingredients: 3 dashes hot pepper sauce (such as Frank's® RedHot), or more to taste
12 cups fresh broccoli florets, or more to taste
3 cups fruit and nut trail mix
0.5 large red onion, diced into 1/4-inch pieces

steps.text: Mix together mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, and hot sauce in a medium bowl until smooth. Set aside to allow sugar to dissolve into dressing.

Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon slices on paper towels and let cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Crumble.
Combine crumbled bacon, broccoli, trail mix, and red onion in a large serving bowl. Add dressing and toss thoroughly.
